what: Plays C64 SID music from HVSC on an emulated 6581 or 8580 and lets you remix every voice live: transpose, mute, solo, swap waveforms, bend envelopes and filter, add LFOs, ride the tempo. Out of the jack, as USB audio or over ASID to a real SID. MIDI clock from the tune, or the tune synced to yours.
author: thomasj (tubesockor)
